title: Same text, no movement: six repaints

clips.label: Krea RAW
clips.details:
Opening uses 52 Euler intervals and the official resolution-dependent shifted grid. RAW generated the wide inset within this square canvas itself. Its median repaint took 36.23 seconds. Fine foam still simplifies over recurrence.

Same porcelain-wave text, 1024×1024, no movement, six recurrent repaints after each model creates its own opening. Starting noise 0.60 and paired seeds. Seven paintings, held for 0.5s each, encoded at 24 fps; no interpolation. This compares model recipes, not distillation alone. Different starting compositions and occupied areas prevent a fair ranking by whole-image pixel difference.

clips.label: Krea Turbo
clips.details:
Opening uses eight Euler intervals with shift 1.15. Median repaint 4.88 seconds. Its foam becomes more rounded and the ceramic patterns change across the six repaints.
